sys_atf_test.description: Validates that the Lock Contract Type business rule allows an admin user to change contract_type even when type-specific cost data (CPFF fee) exists. Creates a proposal with contract_type=cpff, adds a CPFF fee record, then changes contract_type to tm as an admin user and asserts the update succeeds.
sys_atf_test.name: Contract Type Lock - Admin Allowed With Warning
